description: This PHP class defines the DayOfMonthField for scheduling, handling special cron expressions like 'L' for last day and 'W' for nearest weekday, with methods for checking satisfaction, incrementing dates, and validation.

classes.description: A class representing the day-of-month field in a cron expression, with logic for special characters and date calculations.

methods.name: getNearestWeekday

methods.description: Checks if a given date satisfies the cron day-of-month condition.
